description: Use this when the user asks about a clothing brand's materials or sustainability, for example "is Vuori sustainable", "is Vuori non-toxic", "does Vuori use PFAS", "is Lululemon mostly polyester" or "what are Quince clothes made of". Returns how the brand's products that Greener Closet has analyzed score, how many contain synthetic fibers, and any sourced claims on file. It never rates the company itself, and it can't say whether a brand uses PFAS finishes. Do not use this for one product (use check_product) or to find other brands (use find_alternatives).
name: check_brand
title: Check a clothing brand
